createChange.name: Raise a change
createChange.description: Raises a change from the request, linked to the CIs it picked, and can submit it to its CAB authorization.
createChange.title: Title
createChange.changeTypeField: Take the change type from this answer
createChange.changeTypeFieldHelp: Used when the answer is normal or emergency; otherwise the change type above. A form never raises a pre-approved standard change.
createChange.riskField: Take the risk from this answer

createChange.submitHelp: Starts the change's own approval (the CAB when its risk or CIs need it). It is never skipped.
createChange.submitted: Change raised and submitted for authorization
createChange.windowPassed: Change raised; its planned window had already passed, so it wasn’t submitted for authorization
